A collection of 3 wheel packs featuring 72 custom wheel designs in total, including real-life wheels and BMW- and Dodge-inspired designs adapted with ETK and Bastion logos.

Includes:
- 52 real-life wheel designs, all with adjustable sizes ranging from 17x9 to 19x9.
- BMW Style ETK Wheelpack — 14 BMW-inspired wheels with ETK logos.
- Dodge Style Bastion Wheelpack — 6 Dodge-inspired wheels with Bastion logos.
